svg.title: One mini. Remote radar.
svg.desc: Top-view breadboard assembly drawing. Refer to the generated wiring table and validation report.
svg.text: Nordic PCA10059 + DFRobot SEN0610 / one USB cable
The sensor stays on its pigtail. All interface parts fit on one mini.
Crossings without dots do not join.
B: Nordic headers C8-C17 / G8-G17; USB down.
R4 / R3 / R2 / R1 span C-J on rows 1 / 2 / 3 / 4.
Stagger R4/R2 bodies left; R3/R1 bodies right.
R1 body sits 0.5 mm below its lead-hole row.
C1: H5 > J7; body at right beside rows 8-9.
Divider tap > P0.13 / leave I17 out for voltage check
C1 low > ground; exposed hole B1
Sensor + / USB 5 V, not VDD OUT
P0.15 TX reaches C/R directly; no extra jumper
W3 taps G3, on the same net as right row 4.
J4 returns to B1, on the same ground as D1.
Both endpoints are exposed beside resistor bodies.
Use this map instead of the earlier Rev B mockup.
VDD OUT remains a measurement point only.
Four 10k resistors give 0.75 x radar TX.
Expected 3.3 V high becomes about 2.48 V.
Not suitable for a 5 V UART output.
Leave I17 unplugged; VDD must be 2.9-3.1 V.
Scope tap G3 vs A1 through startup and data.
Use the full voltage gate documented in README.
Check real lead forming, housings and levels.
No firmware, RF or hardware test is implied.
Header-aware connectivity checked / hardware bring-up still required
Editable circuit data + reusable part definitions + renderer / sources and bench notes in README
